dialogues.en:
We ended up walking around the entire shopping arcade,
because we couldn't find anyone who knew about the
fortune-telling store.
dialogues.text:
We ended up walking around the entire shopping arcade,
because we couldn't find anyone who knew about the
fortune-telling store.

dialogues.jp:
呼吸以外、何もしないでベッドにくたっ――と
横たわる。
dialogues.en: "That store was hidden, it was too unnoticeable......"
dialogues.text: "That store was hidden, it was too unnoticeable......"

dialogues.jp:
なかなか知っている人間が見つからず、占屋を
求めて商店街中をクエストするハメになってし
まった。
dialogues.en: I wonder if they really want to do business......
dialogues.text: I wonder if they really want to do business......

dialogues.jp:
「まったく、分かりにくい所にありすぎだって
　の……」
商売する気、ないだろ、あそこ？
dialogues.en: I'm going to stay put and play my game tomorrow.
dialogues.text: I'm going to stay put and play my game tomorrow.

dialogues.en:
I decided to sleep in until noon for sure, and closed my
eyes......
dialogues.text:
I decided to sleep in until noon for sure, and closed my
eyes......

dialogues.jp:
商店街中をクエストするはめになって、足が棒
のようになった。ちかれた。明日こそ１２時ま
で寝てやるぅ〜。
dialogues.en: I lay on the bed, doing nothing but breathing.
dialogues.text: I lay on the bed, doing nothing but breathing.
